title: Midwest county display polygons
source: us-counties: {"boundaries":"US Census Bureau cb_2022_us_county_20m","svi":"CDC/ATSDR SVI 2022 county (ACS 2018-2022)","places":"CDC PLACES county data, 2024 release (model-based estimates from BRFSS 2022; a few measures BRFSS 2021)","ers":"USDA ERS Rural-Urban Continuum Codes 2023; Unemployment & median household income file (BLS LAUS, Census SAIPE)"}
licence: Public domain: US Census Bureau cb_2022 boundaries, CDC/ATSDR SVI 2022, USDA ERS / BLS LAUS unemployment
note: All 437 counties in IL, IN, OH, MI, WI; FIPS order matches s2-midwest-counties.json. Split from attributes to satisfy the 150000-byte cap. Largest part only, ranked by absolute exterior shoelace area minus holes, scaled by cos(mean latitude); holes of that part retained. Duplicate closing vertices removed; "ringsClosed": false. No simplification beyond coordinate rounding. Coordinates rounded to 3 decimals for display; use the companion table's queen graph computed from full source geometry at 4 decimals.
